description: Make a new key. For an `api` or `mobile` project, its clients send it as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. For a private website that another server has to read, such as a private CMS behind a public site, that server sends it as the `x-uarpie-key` header on its requests (store it there as a setting, e.g. CMS_KEY); the website's own logins are untouched. The full key is returned once and cannot be retrieved again: put it straight where it is needed and never log it. Existing keys keep working. It starts opening the app within a minute or two, so wait before testing it.

name.description: A label so the person can tell keys apart, e.g. 'iphone app'.

project.description: Project id (prj_…) or the app's name (slug). Defaults to the project in deploy.json in the current directory.
